subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — party details, data residency & billing
messages:
From: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@parallaxsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@parallaxsys.com
Date: 2027-04-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: MSA & Order Form kickoff — initial asks

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the call earlier — Parallax is ready to move forward for a pilot deployment and we need to get contracting moving. We have two immediate asks before we share the internal SOW and billing PO: 

- Can you share your current MSA and the preferred Order Form template?
- We need a party-sheet (legal names, tax ids, signatory details) for our procurement team.
- Data residency: we must confirm whether you can commit to storing EU customer data in EU regions (this pilot will have EU-based users).
- Security evidence: our security team will need SOC 2 Type II reports and a list of subprocessors.

Target timeline: we hope to have a signed Order Form by the end of next week if possible. Please loop in whichever contacts on your side handle exhibits and billing.

Thanks — Emma

--
Emma Hughes
Head of Procurement, Parallax Systems
emma.hughes@parallaxsys.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@parallaxsys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — initial asks

Hi Emma — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list.

I attached a quick party-sheet template and our standard MSA + Order Form as a starting point. A few notes up front:

- Data residency: We offer region-specific hosting on our Dedicated and Private offerings; for the hosted plan we can provision EU region storage — I'll confirm the specific regions & controls with Kimberly.
- Security evidence: Kimberly, can you attach the latest SOC 2 report and subprocessors list?
- Billing / exhibits: Stephanie will take point on billing contacts and the Exhibit B (billing & SLOs) mapping.

Next steps:
1) Emma — can you populate the attached party-sheet and return with signatory names and tax ids?
2) Kimberly — please send SOC2 + subprocessors to Emma and procurement@parallaxsys.com.
3) Stephanie — I'll defer to you for any pricing exhibit clarifications.

Attaching: Redwood-PartySheet-v2.xlsx (party sheet template), Redwood-MSA-v2027-01.pdf (standard MSA), Redwood-OrderForm-template.docx

On timelines: we'll try to get evidence and an initial redline back within 48 business hours once we have the populated party-sheet.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Manager, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(650) 555-0123
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@parallaxsys.com>, procurement@parallaxsys.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — security evidence and residency notes

Hi Emma — looping in the security details you requested.

Attached: Parallax-MSA-Questions.pdf (responses to common procurement questions), Initial-Redlines-Highlights.docx (callouts we expect to see) and our SOC2_TypeII_2026_summary.pdf (redacted summary). A couple quick callouts for your team: 

- SOC 2: the full report is provided under NDA; the summary attached covers control scope and last audit date. If you need the auditor letter we can provision under the mutual NDA.
- Subprocessors: we use a mix of cloud providers and telemetry vendors — I included a current list. If Parallax requires a subprocessor addendum we can work that into the order form.
- Data residency: for hosted customers we can restrict storage to EU regions for customer data; however, caching and some telemetry (aggregated usage metrics) may route through US-based analytics unless you elect a Dedicated/Private deployment. If EU-only residency is a hard requirement, let's flag it now and we can map a Dedicated deployment option.

Open items for Parallax to confirm:
- Which legal entity will sign (full legal name & signatory email)?
- Is EU-only storage required across all telemetry, or just user content?

I'll stand by to share the redline file (track changes) once we receive the party-sheet.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Emma Hughes <emma.hughes@parallaxsys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@parallaxsys.com
Date: 2027-04-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form kickoff — party details, data residency & billing

Jonas / Kimberly / Stephanie — thanks for the fast responses and the materials.

Quick answers from Parallax:
- Signing entity: Parallax Systems, Inc. (EIN: 94-1234567). Primary signatory will be our CFO, Mark Delaney (mark.delaney@parallaxsys.com).
- Data residency: for the pilot we need EU-only storage of user content; aggregated telemetry may be reviewed, but must be anonymized and not leave EU in identifiable form. If that requires Dedicated instances, please outline delta in cost.
- Procurement: attached our completed party-sheet (see attachment). We will expect SOC2 under NDA — procurement will send the NDA to the address on file unless you can provide a one-way redacted report.

Target: once we see the redline highlights and the draft Exhibit B with pilot pricing, we can route to our CFO for signature next week.

Thanks — Emma

[Attachment: Parallax-Completed-PartySheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
